supporting_observations.claim: WS-BCARTER-01 made repeated proxied HTTPS CONNECT attempts to update.chartmate-imaging.net from 13:38 to 14:08 UTC, at roughly five-minute intervals. Most succeeded; attempts at 13:43 and 13:52 returned 407 and 502 respectively.

At 13:37:57, ben.carter's session launched cmupdate.exe from the per-user AppData\Local\ChartMate directory. Subsequent network records associate PID 3416 for that executable with connections to the explicit proxy around the observed HTTPS attempts.

The observed activity resembles the inventoried ChartMate updater's roughly five-minute update checks, but differs from the inventory: the observed host is update.chartmate-imaging.net and the executable is in a per-user AppData path, while the approved domain is update.chartmate-imaging.com and the inventoried path is under Program Files.

A Sysmon file-create event records cmupdate.exe creating a file at its own executable path shortly after launch; the event does not establish whether this was a legitimate updater replacement or something else.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided proxy records show CONNECT hostnames, outcomes, byte counts, and durations, but do not establish the HTTPS payload or the endpoint's TLS certificate. Relevant examples: T015-00110, T015-00209, T015-00264, T015-00269, T015-00281.
The supplied Sysmon records do not provide a hash, signature, version, or file-origin details for the per-user cmupdate.exe. The process launch and file-create records are T015-00108 and T015-00114.
The stated winsec and Sysmon collection outage is for WS-LPARK-01, not WS-BCARTER-01; the supplied coverage status lists the alerted host among hosts with collection available.
claims_not_established: Whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is controlled or authorized by ChartMate, or is a lookalike endpoint.
Whether the per-user cmupdate.exe is an authentic ChartMate binary or an unauthorized replacement.
What content was exchanged over the HTTPS tunnels, and whether any malicious payload or data transfer occurred.
additional_evidence_needed: Validate the observed .net hostname with ChartMate or the organization's software owner and determine whether it is an authorized endpoint.
Acquire the cmupdate.exe file and verify its hash, digital signature, version, provenance, and installation history; examine the file-create event and resulting file contents.
Obtain TLS certificate and DNS-resolution details for the observed endpoint and, if available, proxy or endpoint evidence sufficient to characterize the HTTPS content.
Check whether this per-user installation and update behavior is expected for WS-BCARTER-01 and ben.carter.
unrelated_findings: WS-BCARTER-01 connected to FILE-HD-01 over SMB, where the server recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON network session. This is separate from the alerted HTTPS activity and merits independent review; the records do not establish what resource was accessed or why. Records: T015-00253, T015-00255, T015-00257.
